sections.heading: In-Game Description
sections.text: A fragment of an old dancer's mask. The original must have been broken into several pieces, and this fragment appears to be the decoration at the top of the mask.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text:
The original mask had broken into three pieces and once all fragments are collected, they'll assemble into the Dancing Dragon Mask, that allows Wolf to increase his Attack Power by 1 in exchange for 5 Skill Points at any Sculptor's Idol.
The other pieces are:
- Left: sold by Pot Noble Koremori for 12 12 in the Fountainhead Palace.
- Right: sold by Pot Noble Harunaga for 7 7 in Hirata Estate.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Once the Truly Precious Bait of a Pot Noble is given to the Great Coloured Carp, the other Noble will disappear from the game for the rest of the playthrough and the remaining one will inherit everything left in the other's stock prior to his disappearance.
- Carries over New Game Plus.
